left.title: Trump files op-ed bashing Democrats on Medicare for all
left.body: President Donald Trump knocked Democrats in incendiary terms ahead of the midterm elections with an op-ed decrying a proposal to establish a single-payer health care system.
left.roundup: President Trump criticizes Democrats for proposing "Medicare For All" in a USA Today Op-ed.

center.title: Trump rips Dems’ embrace of Medicare for all: ‘The centrist Democratic Party is dead’
center.body: President Trump on Wednesday attacked Democrats over their embrace of "Medicare for all," writing in an op-ed for USA Today that the plan would threaten seniors and likening the single-payer plan to radical socialism.
center.roundup: President Trump criticizes Democrats for proposing "Medicare For All" in a USA Today Op-ed.

right.title: Donald Trump: Democrats 'Medicare for All' plan will demolish promises to seniors
right.body: The Democrats want to outlaw private health care plans, taking away freedom to choose plans while letting anyone cross our border. We must win this.
right.roundup: President Trump criticizes Democrats for proposing "Medicare For All" in a USA Today Op-ed.
